h1: Custom Aluminum Badges for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom aluminum badges in bulk for employee IDs, nameplates, or event credentials. Durable and affordable from Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Aluminum badges offer a lightweight yet durable option for employee identification, nameplates, and event credentials. Unlike plastic or fabric badges, aluminum resists bending and fading, making them ideal for daily use in offices, warehouses, or trade shows. Decorate with full-color printing, debossing, or laser engraving for a professional finish that lasts.
heroAltText: Custom aluminum badges with debossed logo and name, perfect for employee IDs and nameplates
